headline: FTISLAND's Lee Hong Ki joins SBS band audition 'Band King'
sub: KARA's Kang Jiyoung, The Rose's Woosung also named masters
source: Source: SBS via Ilgan Sports, Topstar News
caption:
FTISLAND's Lee Hong Ki will be a master on 'Band King,' a new Korea–Japan band audition show from SBS.

The show brings together musicians from both countries to form a global band. Its first master lineup includes Yoon Do-hyun of YB, Lee Hong Ki, Jukjae, Woosung of The Rose, Kangnam and KARA's Kang Jiyoung from Korea, plus SPYAIR's Yosuke, Novelbright's Takenaka Yudai, Ai Otsuka and AILE from Japan. The producers say a legendary Japanese band will also join. 'Band King' airs in January 2027.
